svg.title: GROUP BY by sorting: a group ends where the key changes, and its row goes up
svg.text: SELECT customer_id, count(*), sum(total) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
orders, as the Sort hands them up

g.title: Order 15 comes first: the Sort put the NULL key before every number. A group starts with it: count 1, sum 40.
g.text: the first row: a group starts
key NULL: the Sort put NULL first

g.title: Order 10: its customer_id 1 differs from the group's NULL, so that group is done and its row (NULL, 1, 40) goes up; order 10 starts group 1: count 1, sum 30.
g.text: 1 is not NULL: the key changed
group NULL is done; order 10 starts group 1

g.title: Order 12: customer_id 1 again, the same group: count 2, sum 30 + 50 = 80.
Order 13: its customer_id 2 differs from the group's 1, so that group is done and its row (1, 2, 80) goes up; order 13 starts group 2: count 1, sum 20.
g.text: group 1 is done; order 13 starts group 2

g.title: Order 11: its customer_id 3 differs from the group's 2, so that group is done and its row (2, 1, 20) goes up; order 11 starts group 3: count 1, sum 15.
g.text: group 2 is done; order 11 starts group 3

g.title: Order 14: customer_id 3 again, the same group: count 2, sum 15 + 5 = 20.
The input ends, so the last group is done too: (3, 2, 20) goes up. 4 groups from 6 rows, in key order.
g.text: no more rows: the input ended
